card.name: Scattered mid-sentence words in label text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on varied words inside drug-label sentences, such as partway through 'bronchial', 'ideation' or 'lovastatin', and on verbs like 'obtain' or 'determine'.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: Fires on a middle piece of a longer medical or drug word.
modes.example: a history of bron<<ch>>ial asthma; severe chronic obstructive pulmonary

modes.label: Verbs and nouns in warning sentences
modes.description: Fires on a single word in the middle of a clause about benefit, risk or response.
modes.example: Most patients receiving the combination of two RAS inhibitors do not<< obtain>> any additional benefit compared to monotherapy.

card.plain: It fires on a mix of unrelated words in label text, with no pattern that is easy to describe.
